UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

Glitch

Public wasm surface — one glitch canvas per portrait.

frame

frame — advance the clock + RNG, repack the uniform, draw.

The RNG: one xorshift32 step per frame — x ^= x<<13; x ^= x>>17; x ^= x<<5 (Marsaglia) — maximal period 2³²−1, three shifts of state. The seed goes down as an f32; the shader bitcasts it back to u32 for the hash mixer (bit-exact round trip — the seed's low 24 bits are the only ones that survive f32, which is why the mixer uses the HIGH bits via the second shift).

  • @param dt Frame delta in seconds (roll-bar clock).
  • @returns false once the surface is stale/lost.
  • @param {number} dt
  • @returns {boolean}

init

init — device + pipeline + sampler; the bind group builds once the portrait lands (upload → rebind).

  • @param canvas The overlay canvas (positioned over the ).
  • @param device The shared GPUDevice (one per page, from the JS bridge).
  • @returns Ok on a live surface, Err(JsValue) on failure.
  • @param {HTMLCanvasElement} canvas
  • @param {GPUDevice} device

constructor

Glitch::new — un-initialized widget; init must follow.

The RNG seeds from a fixed constant — determinism is a feature: replayed corruption is stable across mounts, and entropy comes from the frame counter, not wall time.

resize

resize — device px — the res uniform (corruption math is px-native: band heights, tear distances, grain).

  • @param w @param h Backing size in device pixels.
  • @param {number} w
  • @param {number} h

set_cover

set_cover — push the cover-fit dest rect (device px) — the DOM coverRect() parity value so the shader's frag→uv mapping matches object-fit: cover + object-position exactly.

  • @param dx @param dy Dest rect origin (device px).
  • @param dw @param dh Dest rect size (device px).
  • @param {number} dx
  • @param {number} dy
  • @param {number} dw
  • @param {number} dh

set_hover

set_hover — the intensity latch: 0 = idle ambient, 1 = full VHS. Mirrors session.hover.

  • @param hover 0 or 1.
  • @param {number} hover

set_size

set_size — CSS px (kept for bridge contract parity; the shader reads device px from resize only).

  • @param _w @param _h CSS size — unused.
  • @param {number} _w
  • @param {number} _h

upload

upload — stage the decoded portrait. ImageBitmap input — the browser decodes off-main-thread and copyExternalImageToTexture moves pixels GPU→GPU, so no CPU pixel round-trip ever touches the glitch path.

NOTE on CORS: the portrait is cross-origin — the copy REQUIRES the image be fetched with crossorigin or the bitmap is tainted and the copy throws. The JS arm catches that and keeps the 2D fallback alive — the stays the source of truth.

  • @param bitmap The decoded portrait (createImageBitmap(img)).
  • @returns true when the texture landed, false before init.
  • @param {ImageBitmap} bitmap
  • @returns {boolean}
